endpoints.name: Audio Transcription
endpoints.description: Transcribe an audio file from a public URL into text using Audioconvert AI.
endpoints.details: Provide a direct public audio-file URL. The endpoint uploads it to Audioconvert, checks guest quota, submits transcription, and waits for the transcript. Maximum audio size is 25 MB; transcription may take up to about 100 seconds.

params.name: url
params.description: Direct public URL to an audio file. Use a file URL, not a web page URL.

params.name: language
params.description: Optional language code; leave empty for automatic detection.

params.name: session
params.description: Session token returned by a previous response; expires after 30 minutes.

endpoints.name: Body Generator
endpoints.description: Live3D tool — Body Generator (demo-ai-body-v1).
endpoints.details: Create a Live3D txt2img task for "body-generator" and wait for the generated result. Requests go through a rotating proxy pool (ProxyScrape) with ALLOW_DIRECT fallback, and use RSA+AES signed headers. Returns the output image URL / metadata on success, or the task_id when the free queue takes too long.

params.name: timeoutMs
params.description: Wait time in ms before giving up (default 120000).

endpoints.name: VIXO Video Generator

endpoints.details: The endpoint auto-provisions a VIXO account scoped to the caller's IP (hidden), creates a video project with the provided params, and returns the project id and status. Free-tier accounts carry 100 credits; keep target_seconds and visual_density modest to stay under the cap.

params.name: idea
params.description: Prompt/idea for the video (used when script is not provided).
params.placeholder: A short fun fact about space, 20 seconds.

params.name: script
params.description: Full script. When set, the 'from my script' path is used instead of idea expansion.

params.name: voice_id
params.description: Voices table UUID. Omit to use the account default voice.

params.name: target_seconds
params.description: Target video length in seconds. Free plan max_duration is 120.

params.name: website_url
params.description: For saas_explainer projects: the website to explain.

params.name: generate
params.description: When true, attempts full browser rendering (requires puppeteer-real-browser on the server). Defaults to false; without it the project is created in draft and can be resumed in the VIXO UI.

endpoints.name: Spotify Downloader
endpoints.description: Resolve Spotify track metadata and any officially available preview audio.
endpoints.details: Accepts a Spotify track URL or track ID and returns track metadata, cover art and an official preview URL when Spotify provides one. It does not rip or bypass Spotify access controls.

params.name: url
params.description: Spotify track URL or 22-character track ID.

endpoints.name: SSSTik TikTok Downloader
endpoints.description: Extract TikTok video, audio and photo download links with creator and media metadata via SSSTik.
endpoints.details: Supports public TikTok, tt.site and Douyin URLs. Results depend on SSSTik availability and its current page format.

params.name: url
params.description: Public TikTok video or post URL.

endpoints.name: Threads Downloader
endpoints.description: Retrieve downloadable video, image and audio links from a public Threads post.
endpoints.details: Provide a public Threads post URL to retrieve author details, caption, thumbnails and available media download URLs.

endpoints.name: TikTok Downloader
endpoints.description: Resolve TikTok video and audio download links with title and thumbnail metadata.
endpoints.details: Accepts a public TikTok video URL and returns available video and MP3 links from the SnapTik provider.

endpoints.name: TikTok MP3 Downloader
endpoints.description: Extract the available audio download link from a TikTok video URL.
endpoints.details: Requires a TikTok video URL. For keyword discovery, use the TikTok Search endpoint first, then pass a result URL here.

params.name: url
params.description: TikTok video URL to extract audio from.

endpoints.name: YouTube Download
endpoints.description: Convert a YouTube video to an MP3 audio or MP4 video download link.
endpoints.details: Provide a YouTube video URL. The converter returns MP3 and MP4 links; choose the format with the format parameter.

params.name: url
params.description: YouTube video, Shorts, live, or youtu.be URL.

params.name: format
params.description: Output format: mp3 or mp4. Defaults to mp3.

endpoints.name: YouTube Downloader V2
endpoints.description: Convert YouTube videos and Shorts to MP3 audio or MP4 video using the Y2Mate converter.
endpoints.details: Accepts YouTube watch, Shorts, live, embed, and youtu.be links. Returns source-site metadata and an MP3/MP4 download URL after conversion completes.

params.name: url
params.description: YouTube video, Shorts, live, embed, or youtu.be URL.

params.name: format
params.description: Output format: mp3 or mp4. Defaults to mp3.

endpoints.name: YouTube MP3 Downloader
endpoints.description: Convert a YouTube video to an MP3 audio download link.
endpoints.details: Accepts YouTube watch, Shorts, live, embed, and youtu.be links. Returns an MP3 download URL after conversion completes.

params.name: url
params.description: YouTube video, Shorts, live, embed, or youtu.be URL.

endpoints.name: YouTube Video Downloader
endpoints.description: Convert a YouTube video or Short into an MP4 download link.
endpoints.details: Returns the MP4 download URL and video metadata. The conversion is handled by the configured third-party converter.

params.name: url
params.description: YouTube video, Shorts, live, or youtu.be URL.

endpoints.name: Bible Verse
endpoints.description: Look up Bible verses by book, chapter and verse reference.
endpoints.details: Provide a reference such as John 3:16 or Psalm 23:1 to retrieve the verse text and the next-verse reference when available.

endpoints.name: Murotal Quran Audio
endpoints.description: Find Quran recitation audio by reciter and surah.
endpoints.details: Search for a reciter and surah name or number. Defaults to Abdul Rahman Al-Sudais reciting Al-Waqiah.

params.name: surah
params.description: Surah name or number from 1 to 114.

endpoints.name: 4K Wallpaper Search
endpoints.description: Search 4K Wallpapers for wallpaper titles, previews, keywords and source pages.
endpoints.details: Search 4kwallpapers.com using the q parameter. Returns wallpaper metadata and preview/source URLs; it does not download image files.

endpoints.name: Apple Music Details
endpoints.description: Fetch details for a song, album, artist or playlist from Apple Music.
endpoints.details: Returns rich metadata for an Apple Music resource by ID or by a full music.apple.com link. Albums and playlists include their track listings.

params.name: id
params.description: Apple Music resource ID, or a full music.apple.com URL.

params.name: type
params.description: Resource type: song, album, artist or playlist. Optional when URL is provided.

params.name: country
params.description: Storefront country code. Defaults to us.

endpoints.name: Apple Music Search
endpoints.description: Search Apple Music for songs, albums, artists and playlists.
endpoints.details: Searches Apple Music's public catalog API and returns matching songs, albums, artists and playlists with metadata, URLs and artwork.

params.name: q
params.description: Search term (song, album, artist or playlist).

params.name: country
params.description: Storefront country code (ISO 3166-2). Defaults to us.

params.name: limit
params.description: Max results per type (1–25). Defaults to 10.

endpoints.name: Bing Web & Image Search
endpoints.description: Search the web or find image URLs through Bing.
endpoints.details: Use type=web for page results or type=image for image URLs.

endpoints.name: China Pics
endpoints.description: Fetch a random China image.
endpoints.details: Fetches a random image from the public Pies image API for china and returns it as a base64 data URL with its content type.

endpoints.name: DuckDuckGo Search
endpoints.description: Search the web using DuckDuckGo HTML and Lite result pages.
endpoints.details: Returns titles, URLs, snippets, domains, positions and favicons when available. Uses a zero-dependency scraper with fallback between DuckDuckGo HTML and Lite.

params.name: region
params.description: DuckDuckGo region code, such as wt-wt, us-en or uk-en.

endpoints.name: HappyMod Search & Download
endpoints.description: Search HappyMod and return app details plus download information in one response.
endpoints.details: Pass q as an app name or HappyMod URL. Search results and the first matching app's download metadata are returned together.

params.name: q
params.description: App name or HappyMod app URL.

endpoints.name: India Pics
endpoints.description: Fetch a random India image.
endpoints.details: Fetches a random image from the public Pies image API for india and returns it as a base64 data URL with its content type.

endpoints.name: Indonesia Pics
endpoints.description: Fetch a random Indonesia image.
endpoints.details: Fetches a random image from the public Pies image API for indonesia and returns it as a base64 data URL with its content type.

endpoints.name: Japan Pics
endpoints.description: Fetch a random Japan image.
endpoints.details: Fetches a random image from the public Pies image API for japan and returns it as a base64 data URL with its content type.

endpoints.name: Korea Pics
endpoints.description: Fetch a random Korea image.
endpoints.details: Fetches a random image from the public Pies image API for korea and returns it as a base64 data URL with its content type.

endpoints.name: Lyrics Search
endpoints.description: Search for song lyrics and return plain and synchronized lyrics when available.
endpoints.details: Looks up lyrics using LRCLIB. Provide a song title, optionally with artist, or a Spotify track URL.

params.name: q
params.description: Song title, artist and/or Spotify track URL.

params.name: artist
params.description: Optional artist name to improve matching.

endpoints.name: Lyrics V2
endpoints.description: Search Genius songs or scrape lyrics from a Genius song URL using one endpoint.
endpoints.details: Provide q for song search, or url for scraping lyrics from a Genius song page. Credit: Nabees Tech.

params.name: q
params.description: Song title, artist or search query. Use this to search Genius.

params.name: url
params.description: Genius song page URL. If provided, lyrics are scraped instead of searching.

endpoints.name: Malaysia Pics
endpoints.description: Fetch a random Malaysia image.
endpoints.details: Fetches a random image from the public Pies image API for malaysia and returns it as a base64 data URL with its content type.

endpoints.name: NetShort Details
endpoints.description: Get NetShort drama details, episode list and any download/media URLs exposed by the source page.
endpoints.details: Pass a drama slug or NetShort episode/full-episodes URL. Download information is included in the same response; no separate download endpoint is needed.

endpoints.name: NetShort Download
endpoints.description: Resolve media and download links for a NetShort drama or episode.
endpoints.details: Pass a NetShort episode URL or drama slug using the url parameter. Returns media URLs and any download links exposed by NetShort.

params.name: url
params.description: NetShort episode URL or drama slug.

endpoints.name: NetShort Search
endpoints.description: Search NetShort dramas and episodes by title or slug.
endpoints.details: Searches the NetShort all-episodes listing. Use q as the drama title or slug.

endpoints.name: Pinterest Search
endpoints.description: Search Pinterest pins and return image/video media links and creator metadata.
endpoints.details: Searches public Pinterest pins by keyword. Filter by image, video, or all and optionally paginate with the returned bookmark.

params.name: type
params.description: Filter results: image, video, or all.

params.name: bookmark
params.description: Bookmark returned by a previous response for pagination.

endpoints.name: Shazam Recognize
endpoints.description: Identify a song from an audio file URL using Shazam fingerprinting.
endpoints.details: Downloads the audio at a URL, generates a Shazam-compatible acoustic fingerprint via a local FFT pipeline (ffmpeg required on the server), and returns the matched track metadata, cover art, Apple Music link and preview.

params.name: url
params.description: Direct URL to an audio file (mp3, m4a, ogg, wav, etc.).

params.name: offset
params.description: Start offset in seconds. Defaults to 0 (or song midpoint when audio is long).

params.name: duration
params.description: Analyze window in seconds (3–30). Defaults to 12.

params.name: country
params.description: Two-letter country code for regional metadata. Defaults to US.

params.name: language
params.description: Locale for results (e.g. en-US). Defaults to en-US.

endpoints.name: Spotify Search
endpoints.description: Search Spotify tracks and return track metadata and links.
endpoints.details: Searches Spotify's public web search page and returns matching tracks with artists, albums, durations, cover art and Spotify URLs.

params.name: q
params.description: Track, artist or album search query.

endpoints.name: Sticker Search
endpoints.description: Search SigStick for sticker packs and retrieve sticker image URLs.
endpoints.details: Searches SigStick by keyword and returns matching pack metadata. Pass a returned pack URL as packUrl to retrieve its sticker image URLs. This API returns sticker data; it does not send or install WhatsApp sticker packs.

params.name: q
params.description: Keyword to search for sticker packs. The keyword alias is also accepted.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum packs to return (1–20). Defaults to 10.

params.name: packUrl
params.description: Optional SigStick pack URL returned by search; when supplied, returns that pack's sticker image URLs.

endpoints.name: Stickerly Search
endpoints.description: Search Stickerly for sticker packs by keyword.
endpoints.details: Searches Stickerly's public smart-search API and returns matching pack metadata, sticker resource filenames, and share URLs. This endpoint searches and lists packs; it does not upload or send WhatsApp sticker packs.

params.name: q
params.description: Keyword to search for sticker packs. The keyword parameter is also accepted.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of packs to return (1–20). Defaults to 10.

endpoints.name: Thailand Pics
endpoints.description: Fetch a random Thailand image.
endpoints.details: Fetches a random image from the public Pies image API for thailand and returns it as a base64 data URL with its content type.

endpoints.name: TikTok Search
endpoints.description: Search TikTok videos by keyword and return video URLs and metadata.
endpoints.details: Use this endpoint to find TikTok videos. Pass a result's url to the TikTok MP3 Downloader endpoint to retrieve its audio link.

params.name: q
params.description: Keywords to search for on TikTok.

params.name: count
params.description: Maximum number of results (1-10). Defaults to 10.

endpoints.name: Vietnam Pics
endpoints.description: Fetch a random Vietnam image.
endpoints.details: Fetches a random image from the public Pies image API for vietnam and returns it as a base64 data URL with its content type.

endpoints.name: Wikipedia
endpoints.description: Look up Wikipedia articles and return summaries, article URLs and thumbnail images.
endpoints.details: Fetches the English Wikipedia summary for a page title or search phrase. Returns the title, extract, article URL, page ID and available thumbnail.

params.name: q
params.description: Wikipedia article title or search phrase.

endpoints.name: YouTube Search
endpoints.description: Search YouTube videos and return titles, channels, views, durations and thumbnails.
endpoints.details: Search YouTube by keyword and receive up to 10 video results with watch URLs.

endpoints.name: Free Fire Stalk
endpoints.description: Look up a Free Fire player profile using their numeric UID.
endpoints.details: Returns available public player details, ranks, activity dates, equipped items, pet, guild, social signature, credit score, and ban status.

endpoints.name: Pinterest Stalk
endpoints.description: Look up publicly available Pinterest profile information by username.
endpoints.details: Returns available profile details, follower/following counts, verification status, profile score, board statistics, and up to 100 boards from Pinout's profile analyzer.

endpoints.name: Roblox Stalk
endpoints.description: Look up a public Roblox account profile by username.
endpoints.details: Returns profile details, social counts, avatar body and equipped items with thumbnails, presence, groups, badges, username history and favorite games.

params.name: username
params.description: Roblox username, with or without the leading @.

endpoints.name: Threads Stalk
endpoints.description: Look up public Threads profile details by username.
endpoints.details: Fetches publicly exposed Threads profile metadata, including display name, follower and thread counts when available, bio, avatar, and profile URL.

params.name: username
params.description: Threads username, with or without the leading @.

endpoints.name: TikTok Stalk
endpoints.description: Look up publicly available TikTok profile information by username.
endpoints.details: Returns available username, nickname, user ID, bio, avatar URLs, follower and engagement counts, privacy and verification flags, and account creation time when exposed publicly.

params.name: username
params.description: TikTok username, with or without the leading @.

endpoints.name: Face Swap
endpoints.description: Swap a face between two images using the Nabees face-swap provider.
endpoints.details: Provide source and target as public image URLs or base64 image data (raw base64 or a data:image/...;base64,... string). Each image is limited to 10 MB. Returns the generated image URL.

params.name: source
params.description: Source/face image URL or base64 image data.

params.name: target
params.description: Target image URL or base64 image data.

endpoints.name: Ghibli Image
endpoints.description: Restyle an image as whimsical hand-painted anime artwork.
endpoints.details: Provide a public image URL. Returns the generated image as a data URL or provider URL.

params.name: image_url
params.description: Public HTTP(S) URL of the image to transform.

endpoints.name: Image to Text (OCR)
endpoints.description: Extract readable text from an image using OCR.
endpoints.details: Provide a public image URL. Supports PNG, JPEG, WEBP, GIF, BMP, and TIFF up to 12 MB. Returns extracted text and the provider's raw text. Depends on the third-party imagetotext.info service.

params.name: image
params.description: Public HTTP(S) URL of the image to read (maximum 12 MB).

endpoints.name: Nano Banana
endpoints.description: Edit an existing image using a natural-language prompt with Nano Banana Lite.
endpoints.details: Provide a public image URL and an editing prompt. Returns the generated image as base64 with its MIME type and size. This API endpoint does not implement the WhatsApp plugin's per-sender daily limit.

params.name: image
params.description: Public HTTP(S) URL of the image to edit (PNG, JPEG, WEBP, or GIF; max 12 MB).

params.name: prompt
params.description: Describe the changes to make to the image.

endpoints.name: Remini Upscaler
endpoints.description: Upscale an image to 2x or 4x resolution using iLoveIMG.
endpoints.details: Provide a public image URL and choose style 2x or 4x (defaults to 2x). Returns the upscaled image as base64 with MIME type and size.

params.name: image
params.description: Public HTTP or HTTPS URL of the image to upscale. Maximum source size 15 MB.

endpoints.name: Remove Background
endpoints.description: Remove the background from an image and return a transparent PNG.
endpoints.details: Provide a public image URL. The endpoint downloads the source image, processes it with Pixelcut, and returns the transparent PNG as base64 together with its MIME type and size.

params.name: image
params.description: Public HTTP or HTTPS URL of the image to remove the background from. Maximum source size 15 MB.

endpoints.name: To Anime
endpoints.description: Transform a photo into polished Japanese anime artwork.
endpoints.details: Provide a public image URL. Returns the generated anime image as a data URL or provider URL.

params.name: image_url
params.description: Public HTTP(S) URL of the image to transform.

endpoints.name: To Zombie
endpoints.description: Transform a photo into a realistic cinematic horror zombie.
endpoints.details: Provide a public image URL. Returns the generated zombie image as a data URL or provider URL.

params.name: image_url
params.description: Public HTTP(S) URL of the image to transform.

endpoints.name: FreeConvert File Converter
endpoints.description: Convert a publicly accessible file URL to another format using FreeConvert.
endpoints.details: Submits a conversion job, uploads the source file and returns a download URL when complete. Source files are limited to 25 MB.

params.name: format
params.description: Target file format, without the dot.

endpoints.name: SFL Link Bypasser
endpoints.description: Resolve an SFL short link to its destination URL.
endpoints.details: Attempts the SFL redirect and verification flow and returns the final destination when available.

endpoints.name: Temporary Gmail
endpoints.description: Create a temporary email address using the temp.tf provider.
endpoints.details: Requests a temporary email address for the selected provider. Use the returned email with the inbox-check endpoint to retrieve messages.

endpoints.name: Temporary Mail Inbox
endpoints.description: Check a temporary email address for available messages.
endpoints.details: Performs one provider inbox check using temp.tf's wait option. It does not keep an HTTP request polling forever; call again to check for later messages.

endpoints.name: TinyURL Shortener
endpoints.description: Shorten a long HTTP or HTTPS URL with TinyURL.
endpoints.details: Returns a TinyURL short link for a supplied URL.

params.name: url
params.description: The HTTP or HTTPS URL to shorten.

endpoints.name: Translate
endpoints.description: Translate text into a selected language using Google Translate.
endpoints.details: Automatically detects the source language. Provide text and a target language code such as en, id, fr, or yo.

params.name: lang
params.description: Target language code, for example en, id, fr, or yo.

endpoints.name: Upstash Sandbox Creator
endpoints.description: Create a new Upstash Box SSH sandbox and return its SSH login details.
endpoints.details: Provisions a fresh Upstash Box (sandbox) using the verified account's API key and returns the SSH host/user/command/password, console and preview URLs, and remaining free-tier CPU hours. SSH password is the Box API key.

params.name: name
params.description: Optional display name for the new sandbox.

params.name: browser
params.description: Enable browser support for the sandbox.

endpoints.name: Web Screen Record
endpoints.description: Record a public webpage as an MP4 video in a selected device layout.
endpoints.details: Returns the video URL from the BentoSnap website recording service. Duration is specified in milliseconds.

params.name: url
params.description: Public webpage URL. A missing scheme is treated as HTTPS.

params.name: device
params.description: Viewport preset: desktop_fhd, desktop, tablet, or mobile.

endpoints.name: Web Screenshot
endpoints.description: Capture a screenshot of a public webpage in a selected device layout.
endpoints.details: Returns the screenshot image URL from the BentoSnap screenshot service.

params.name: url
params.description: Public webpage URL. A missing scheme is treated as HTTPS.

params.name: device
params.description: Viewport preset: desktop_fhd, desktop, tablet, or mobile.

endpoints.name: Web to PDF
endpoints.description: Convert a public webpage into a downloadable PDF document.
endpoints.details: Provide a webpage URL. The endpoint waits for conversion and returns PDF metadata plus the PDF as base64.

params.name: url
params.description: Public webpage URL to convert to PDF. A missing scheme is treated as HTTPS.

endpoints.name: Web2APK Converter
endpoints.description: Build an Android APK wrapper for a website using a supplied app name and PNG icon.
endpoints.details: Provide url, appName, and icon. The icon must be a direct public URL to a PNG image. Returns APK download metadata and the APK as a base64 string.

params.name: url
params.description: Website URL to package into an Android app.

params.name: appName
params.description: Display name for the generated Android app.

params.name: icon
params.description: Direct public URL to a PNG image; maximum image size 2 MB.

endpoints.name: Website to ZIP
endpoints.description: Copy a public website and package its downloaded files into a ZIP archive.
endpoints.details: Provide a website URL. The endpoint waits for the archive to finish, then returns ZIP metadata and the archive as base64.

params.name: url
params.description: Public website URL to copy. Must start with http:// or https://.

endpoints.name: WhatsApp Poll Boost
endpoints.description: Boost a vote on a WhatsApp channel poll via the external poll vote service.

endpoints.details: Returns an artist's public profile: bio, socials, statistics, follower count and upload counts. Requires the artist's URL slug.

endpoints.name: Audiomack Chart
endpoints.description: Get Audiomack charts by kind and period.
endpoints.details: Returns chart rankings for songs, albums or playlists over a daily, weekly, monthly, yearly or all-time period.

params.name: kind
params.description: Chart kind: songs, albums or playlists.

params.name: period
params.description: Period: daily, weekly, monthly, yearly or total.

endpoints.name: Audiomack Genre
endpoints.description: Get Audiomack tracks by genre (trending, recent or chart).
endpoints.details: Returns trending, recent or charted tracks for a given genre (e.g. afrobeats, rap). For charts you can choose songs/albums and a period.

params.name: period
params.description: For charts: daily, weekly, monthly, yearly or total.

endpoints.name: Audiomack Play
endpoints.description: Resolve an Audiomack song's streaming URL.
endpoints.details: Returns a signed, time-limited streaming URL and play UUID for a song. The URL expires after a short window, so use it promptly.

endpoints.name: Audiomack Playlist
endpoints.description: Get an Audiomack playlist by artist and playlist slugs.
endpoints.details: Returns a playlist's metadata and contained tracks using its artist slug and playlist slug.

endpoints.name: Audiomack Recent
endpoints.description: Get recently uploaded songs on Audiomack.
endpoints.details: Returns the most recently uploaded songs on Audiomack with full metadata: artist, genre, duration, statistics and artwork.

endpoints.name: Audiomack Search
endpoints.description: Search Audiomack songs, artists, albums and playlists.
endpoints.details: Searches Audiomack's public catalog and returns matching music, with track metadata, statistics, artwork and stream info.

params.name: q
params.description: Search term (song, artist, album or playlist).

endpoints.name: Audiomack Song
endpoints.description: Get an Audiomack song by ID or artist/song slugs.

params.name: artist
params.description: Artist slug (when using slugs instead of id).

params.name: song
params.description: Song slug (when using slugs instead of id).

endpoints.name: Audiomack Trending
endpoints.description: Get currently trending songs on Audiomack.
